notes.title: DLC Patch
notes.content:
Musk DLC is here!! You can now play as the mysterious Mr. Musk on his spacestation, while the President is down on earth.

There are bugs haha, I'm working on fixing the last few tho!!!

Enjoy, my fellow Americans.

-Luke

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
Patch #2:

You now have a weight measuring mechanic. 
Weigh yourself after you eat too many TonsaBurgers. If you're too fat, use the treadmill downstairs to burn off weight!

Achievements are here.
